journey.name: profile deletion progress
journey.description: Precondition: an onboarded disposable test wallet with Paykit enabled and a profile created through Bitkit. The profile and its contacts will be deleted; do not use a personal identity. Record the sequence so progress can be checked even when deletion completes quickly. Start with zero contacts and record the deletion time without a fixed latency target. Repeat with 62 imported contacts, once after preparation settles and once immediately after import. Measure confirmation to onboarding and check logs for any uncertain-write safety wait. During deletion, check the indicator on Delete Profile. Save stays disabled with its label visible. Cleanup may still wait for admitted operations and remote safety checks; no fixed duration is expected. See the suite README for controlled automatic-admission, contact-link cancellation, deletion-failure ordering and public-publication retry checks.

actions.action: Open the existing profile from the Home header
Scroll to Delete Profile and tap it
Verify a progress indicator is visible while deletion is pending and profile actions cannot be used
Wait for deletion to finish and verify profile onboarding is shown
Return Home and reopen Profile; verify the deleted profile does not reappear
